$comment: expected E109: the inline `CoincidentAxesJoint` gives ports a and b the same z screw S = [1, 0, 0], so its joint-space mass SᵀMS = J*[[1,1],[1,1]] has rank 1: only qa+qb is determined and qa-qb has no inertia. Two independent torque sources drive a and b with J = 0.02 kg*m^2, so the parameters are valid and this is E109, not E108.
name: SemanticE109SingularMass

inline.source:
@block CoincidentAxesJoint begin
    @ports begin
        a::Power{Rotation}, [frame = "arm"]
        b::Power{Rotation}, [frame = "arm"]
    end
    @parameters J::Real = 0.02, [unit = "kg*m^2", min = 0, description = "Valid rotor inertia"]
    @variables begin
        qa::Real = 0.0, [unit = "rad", state = :prefer]
        qb::Real = 0.0, [unit = "rad", state = :prefer]
        Pa::Real = 0.0, [unit = "N*m*s", state = :prefer]
        Pb::Real = 0.0, [unit = "N*m*s", state = :prefer]
    end
    @equations begin
        # Both axes use the same z screw S = [1, 0, 0]. With M = J, the joint-space
        # mass Sᵀ M S = J * [1 1; 1 1] has rank 1: only qa+qb is determined and the
        # relative coordinate qa-qb has no inertia, so its acceleration is free.
        a.f ~ ddt(qa)
        b.f ~ ddt(qb)
        Pa ~ J * (ddt(qa) + ddt(qb))
        Pb ~ J * (ddt(qa) + ddt(qb))
        ddt(Pa) ~ a.e
        ddt(Pb) ~ b.e
    end
    @causality (a, b) => :transformer
end
